name: content-to-video
title_zh: 把任意素材端到端变成一条成片级 MP4 视频
tagline_zh: README、故事、PPT、数据报告、甚至一句话题——丢进去，自动分类意图、选版式、定节奏、挑配音。
tagline_en: Drop in a README, story, deck, or bare topic—it auto-classifies intent, picks layout, pacing, and TTS, then.
desc_en: Turn arbitrary source content (README, article, story, slides, deck, data/report, product description, tutorial text, audio/transcript, or a bare topic) into a finished, high-quality MP4 video. Classifies the content type and user intent, picks the right pipeline, format preset (16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1), pacing, visual strategy, and TTS voice, then runs production end-to-end (message + storyboard with a
why_zh: 不是模板拼接，而是先判内容类型与用户意图，再选 pipeline、画幅、节奏和视觉策略——每个决定都有。
why_en: It doesn't stitch templates—it classifies content type and intent first, then selects pipeline, aspect, pacing, and visual.
limit_zh: 只认描述里列出的八类输入（README/文章/故事/幻灯片/数据报告/产品介绍/教程/音频转写），超出会卡在分类步。
limit_en: Only handles the 8 listed input types (README/article/story/slides/data/product/tutorial/transcript); others stall at classification. Output is MP4.
